DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。拾った物のことで、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with something you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯を拾いました。着信に一度出たら持ち主だと言われましたが、直接渡さずこちらへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った携帯の着信に一度出て持ち主と言われたが、直接渡さず警察へ届けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a phone. I answered an incoming call once, and the caller said they were the owner, but I brought it here instead of handing it over directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you answered a call on a found phone and were told the caller was the owner, but handed it to police instead of delivering it directly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻、電話で話した内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where and when you found it and what was said on the phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スーパーの外で夕方です。電話の人は近くへ来ると言いましたが、待ち合わせの約束はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スーパー外で夕方に拾い、相手は近くに来ると言ったが待合せの約束はしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Outside the supermarket in the evening. The caller said they'd come nearby, but I didn't agree to meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found it outside the supermarket in the evening, and although the caller said they would come nearby, you did not arrange a meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで持ち主の確認を行います。携帯の画面を操作したり、中の情報を見たりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll verify ownership here. Did you operate the phone screen or look at information inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 着信に出ただけで、ロックは開けていません。写真や連絡先も見ていません。相手には警察へ届けると伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着信に出ただけでロックは開けず写真や連絡先も見ておらず、相手には警察へ届けると伝えたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only answered the call and didn't unlock it. I haven't looked at photos or contacts either. I told the caller I'd hand it to police.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you only answered the call, did not unlock it or view photos or contacts, and told the caller you would hand it to police. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経緯を記録します。電話がまた来ても、ご自身で本人の確認や受け渡しをする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record that sequence. Even if another call comes, you don't need to verify the person's identity or hand it over yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手が怒るか心配でしたが、直接会う約束をしなくてよかったです。私の連絡先は届け出のために記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手が怒るか不安だったが直接会う約束はせず、自分の連絡先は届出用に記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was worried the person might get angry, but I'm glad I didn't arrange to meet directly. I'll enter my contact details for the report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you worried the caller might get angry but did not arrange a direct meeting, and will enter your own contact details for reporting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。拾得物についてのご意向も説明してから確認します。携帯は今の状態でお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll explain and then confirm your wishes regarding the found property too. Please hand over the phone in its current state.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 拾得場所と時刻、着信に出たこと、約束なし、未開錠を伝えます。持ち主の確認はこちらにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所、時刻、応答、待合せなし、未開錠を示し、持ち主の確認を窓口に任せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give the place and time, that I answered a call, made no meeting arrangement, and didn't unlock it. Please handle verification of the owner here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the location, time, call response, lack of meeting arrangement, and locked state, and say you will leave ownership verification to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。状況を記録してお預かりします。届けていただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll record the circumstances and accept it. Thank you for handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。転居の郵便で、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about mail after moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越しの届けを出したいです。私宛ての郵便は日本語の名前と英字の名前があるので、どちらを書くか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵便の転居届で自分のカタカナ名と英字名の両方が届くため、記入する表記を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to submit a change-of-address notification. Mail for me uses both a Japanese-script name and a Roman-letter name, so I'd like to know which to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you receive mail under both your katakana and Roman-letter names, and ask how to enter them on the postal change-of-address notification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に届いていた宛名と、ご本人の確認書類をもとに案内します。違う表記の例はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll advise based on the actual addressee names used and your identification. Have you brought examples of the different spellings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この封筒二枚です。同じ私宛てですが、一枚はカタカナ、もう一枚は英字です。二人分として書くのではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚の封筒は表記が違っても同じ自分宛てであり、二人分の届出ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two envelopes. Both are for me, but one is in katakana and the other in Roman letters. I shouldn't enter them as two people, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both envelopes are addressed to you despite different spellings and this is not a notification for two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ方の表記について、案内に沿って確認しましょう。旧住所と新住所はどちらも同じ名義で受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's follow the guidance to check the different spellings for one person. Can you receive mail under the same names at both the old and new addresses?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい部屋の郵便受けは、大家さんに英字で名前を出してもらいます。郵便の宛名との違いも、事前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新居の郵便受け表示は英字になるので、届く宛名との相違も事前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The landlord will put my name in Roman letters on my new room's mailbox. I'd also like to discuss any difference from the names on my mail in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the new mailbox name will be in Roman letters and you want to discuss differences from incoming mail's addressee names beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 郵便受けの表示と届出の宛名が確認できるよう、ご説明ください。必要な記載を担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain so the mailbox display and notification names can be checked. We'll ask the staff what entries are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旧住所の部屋番号も書きます。名前の表記だけを直して、住所を省略しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名表記だけでなく旧住所の部屋番号も書き、住所を省略しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write the old room number too. I'll make sure not to omit the address while only correcting the spelling of my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will write the old room number as well as name spellings and will not abbreviate the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。氏名の表記、旧住所、新住所、対象者をそれぞれ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let's check the name spellings, old address, new address, and person covered separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの表記が私一人のものだと示し、両住所を部屋番号まで書きます。担当の案内どおり記入して届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの表記が一人のものと示し、新旧住所を部屋番号まで記入して担当者の案内で届けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show that the two spellings belong to me alone and write both addresses including room numbers. I'll complete and submit it according to the staff's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the two spellings belong to one person, enter old and new addresses through the room numbers, and submit according to staff guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒の例を持ってご相談ください。お手続きありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the example envelopes when asking. Thank you for completing the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。銀行のお手続きで、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about your banking procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ建物の別の部屋へ移りました。番地は同じなので、銀行の住所変更は不要だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ建物の別室へ転居し番地は同じなので、銀行の住所変更は不要だと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved to another room in the same building. The street address is the same, so I thought I didn't need to change my address at the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you moved to another room in the same building and thought no bank address change was needed because the street number stayed the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部屋番号も登録情報として確認します。銀行からの郵便は、新しい部屋へ届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the room number as part of your registered information too. Has bank mail been reaching the new room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の部屋に入って、住んでいる方が渡してくれました。次も受け取れると思わず、部屋番号を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧室の住人から銀行郵便を受け取ったが、次も受け取れるとは考えず部屋番号を直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It went to the old room, and the person living there handed it to me. I won't assume I can receive it again that way; I'd like to correct the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the old room's resident gave you bank mail, but you will not assume that will work next time and want to correct the room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更に必要な確認をご案内します。新しい部屋番号が確認できる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain the checks needed for a change. Do you have a document confirming the new room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所を更新した書類があります。携帯の番号は変わっていませんが、住所変更と一緒に番号が消えないかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所の確認書類を示し、変更のない電話番号が住所変更で影響されないかも確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a document with my updated address. My phone number hasn't changed, but I'd also like to check that changing the address won't remove it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show new-address verification and say you also want to check that the unchanged phone number is not affected by the address change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所と電話番号は別の登録項目です。変更後にどの情報が更新されたか、案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The address and phone number are separate registered fields. After changing it, check the guidance to see which information was updated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 郵便の送付先も新しい部屋にしたいです。番地だけが同じでは十分でないとわかったので、部屋番号まで読み合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 郵便も新室宛てにし、番地だけでは足りないので建物名と部屋番号を読み合わせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like mail sent to the new room too. Now I understand the street address alone isn't enough, I'll read back the details including the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say mail should go to the new room and, since the street number alone is insufficient, you will read back the building name and room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。担当と建物名、部屋番号を照らし合わせてください。通知の再送についても担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please compare the building name and room number with the staff. We'll also ask about resending notices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい部屋番号を示し、電話番号は変更なしと伝えます。郵便の送付先と変更結果を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新室の書類と電話番号は変更なしという内容を示し、郵便送付先と登録変更結果を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the new room number and say the phone number is unchanged. I'll check the mailing address and the result of the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the new-room document and state that the phone number is unchanged, and say you will check the mailing address and registration-change result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本人確認と登録の確認を進めます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll proceed with identification and registration checks. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お買い物で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 五人でパンケーキを作ります。レシピは二人分なので、必要な牛乳の量と、どの包装を買うか一緒に確かめてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分のパンケーキレシピで五人分を作るため、必要な牛乳の量と買う包装の組合せを確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: We're making pancakes for five people. The recipe is for two, so could you check the milk quantity needed and which packages to buy with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are making five portions from a two-person pancake recipe and ask to check the required milk amount and package combination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシピに書かれた牛乳の量を教えてください。今日は五人とも一人分ずつ作る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the milk quantity in the recipe. Are you planning one serving each for all five people today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、五人とも同じ一人分です。レシピは二人分で百二十ミリリットルです。まず五人分の量を計算したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五人とも一人分ずつで、レシピの二人分に牛乳百二十ミリリットルが必要だと示し、五人分を計算したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same single serving for each of the five. The recipe needs 120 milliliters for two. I'd like to calculate the five-person quantity first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say all five need one serving each and the recipe calls for 120 milliliters of milk for two, so you want to calculate the amount for five. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二人分の百二十を五人分にすると、合計三百ミリリットルですね。売場には二百と百の包装があります。量を計る道具はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Scaling 120 for two people to five gives 300 milliliters in total. We have 200 and 100-milliliter packages here. Do you have something to measure with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 百ミリリットルの目盛りがある計量カップを使います。百まで計るのを三回繰り返せば三百ですが、カップ一杯と百の目盛りは分けて考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 百ミリリットルの目盛りがある計量カップを使い、三回で三百になるが、カップ一杯と目盛りを同じだと扱わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use a measuring cup with a 100-milliliter mark. Measuring to 100 three times gives 300, but I want to distinguish a full cup from its 100 mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you will use a cup with a 100-milliliter mark three times for 300, without treating a full cup and the mark as the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、カップの縁までではなく、百ミリリットルの目盛りで三回ですね。包装は一つだけにしますか、それとも二つを組み合わせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, three times to the 100-milliliter mark, not the rim. Will you choose just one package or combine two?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二百の包装一つだけでは百足りません。二百と百を一つずつ買えば、必要な三百にできるので、その組合せにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二百の包装一つでは百足りないため、二百と百を一つずつ買って必要な三百にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One 200-milliliter package alone is 100 short. One 200 and one 100 make the required 300, so I'll choose that combination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say one 200 package is 100 short, so you will buy one 200 and one 100 to reach the needed 300. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの表示の単位も同じミリリットルです。二百と百を合わせて三百になります。レシピの二人分と、今日の五人分のメモを分けておくと、準備の時に見直せますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both labels use the same unit, milliliters. Together, 200 and 100 make 300. Keeping the two-person recipe separate from today's five-person note will let you check again when preparing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシピの百二十をそのまま使わず、五人分は三百とメモします。二百と百の包装を買い、調理する時は百の目盛りで三回計ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人分の百二十ではなく五人分の三百をメモし、二百と百の包装を買って百の目盛りで三回計ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't use the recipe's 120 unchanged; I'll note 300 for five. I'll buy 200 and 100-milliliter packages and measure three times to the 100 mark when cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note 300 for five instead of 120 for two, buy 200 and 100 packages, and measure three times using the 100 mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二百と百の包装はこちらです。人数、必要量、目盛りを確認できましたね。お買い物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The 200 and 100 packages are here. You've checked the people, quantity, and measurement mark. Thank you for shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。休憩場所のことで、何をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to know about rest areas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人とお弁当を食べます。このテーブルが空いているので、荷物を置いて全員分の席を取っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人との食事のため、空いているテーブルに荷物を置いて席を確保してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm having packed lunches with friends. This table is empty, so can I leave bags here to reserve seats for everyone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to eat with friends and ask whether you can reserve an empty table by putting bags on it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所ごとの利用表示を確認してください。予約区画か、自由に利用できる場所かはご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the usage signs for each area. Have you checked whether it's reserved space or available for general use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約の表示がありました。今空いていても、私たちが使えるとは限らないですね。自由に休める場所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約表示があったため空席でも使えるとは限らず、自由に休める場所を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a reservation sign. Even if it's empty now, that doesn't mean we can use it, does it? I'll look for somewhere we can rest freely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you saw a reservation sign, so an empty seat may not be available for you, and you will look for an open-use rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内板の右に、予約不要で食事もできる自由休憩スペースがあります。目の前の予約テーブルは使わず、人数がそろってから空いている場所をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: To the right of the information board is a free-use rest area where eating is allowed without reservations. Don't use the reserved table in front of you; choose an available spot once everyone arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人がまだ来ていません。先に荷物だけ広げず、私が待てる場所と合流点を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人は未到着なので荷物だけ広げず、自分の待機場所と合流点を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friends haven't arrived yet. I won't spread just our bags out first; I'd like to decide where I can wait and where to meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your friends have not arrived, so you will not spread bags out alone and want to decide a waiting and meeting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内板の前で合流できます。通路を空けてお待ちになり、友人に案内板の表示を伝えてください。食事は、全員が来てから右の自由休憩スペースへ移ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can meet in front of this information board. Keep the path clear while waiting and tell your friends what the board says. Once everyone arrives, move to the free-use rest area on the right to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板の前で合流すると連絡します。全員が来てから、利用できる食事場所へ一緒に移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板で合流すると友人に知らせ、全員が来てから使える食事場所へ一緒に移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my friends we're meeting in front of the board. Once everyone arrives, we'll move together to an area where eating is allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friends to meet at the information board and move together to an available eating area after everyone arrives. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方法でご利用ください。自由休憩スペースがいっぱいなら、荷物で場所を取らず、空くまで皆さんで待つか別の場所をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use it that way. If the free-use rest area is full, don't reserve space with bags; all wait together until a place opens or ask about another location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約席を避け、荷物で席を占有せず案内板で待ちます。合流して食事の表示を確認した場所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約区画を避けて荷物で占有せず案内板で待ち、合流後に食事が認められた場所へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll avoid reserved seats and wait at the board without occupying seats with bags. After meeting up, we'll go somewhere whose signs we've checked allow eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid reserved space, not occupy it with bags, wait at the board, and move to a permitted eating area after meeting up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。周りの方と譲り合ってお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy yourselves while sharing considerately with others. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動のご案内で、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 杖を使っています。改札まで階段を避けたいのですが、この小さい案内図が読めません。経路を言葉で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 杖を使い、小さな図が読めないため、階段を避けて改札へ行く道を言葉で説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I use a cane. I'd like to avoid stairs to the ticket gates, but I can't read this small map. Please explain the route in words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you use a cane and cannot read the small diagram, and ask for spoken directions to the ticket gates avoiding stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在地と改札を確認してご説明します。長い距離を続けて歩くことも難しいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check where you are and the gates and explain. Is walking a long distance without stopping difficult too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で一度座りたいです。階段がなくても遠回りなら時間がかかるので、休める所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中で座って休みたいので、遠回りにかかる時間と休める場所も知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to sit once along the way. Even without stairs, a detour takes time, so I'd like to know somewhere to rest too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to sit and rest on the way and want to know the detour's time and resting places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる通路と休憩の場所を確認します。昇降設備の表示があっても、今使えるかを確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check usable paths and rest places. Even if lifts or similar facilities are shown, let's verify whether they're working now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 設備の名前だけでは道順がわからないので、曲がる場所を順番に説明してください。私も言い直して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 設備名だけでは道が分からないため、曲がる場所を順番に説明してもらい、復唱して確かめたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just the equipment names don't tell me the route, so please explain the turns in order. I'll repeat it back to check too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say equipment names alone do not clarify the route, and ask for turns in order so you can repeat and check them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では最初の区間だけご説明します。この案内板を背にして、右側の通路へ進みます。青い札の手前にあるベンチまでです。右というのは、案内板を背にした向きでお伝えしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain only the first section. With your back to this information board, take the path on the right, as far as the bench before the blue sign. By right, I mean when facing away from the information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板を背にして右へ進み、青い札の手前のベンチまでですね。ベンチで一度休んでから、その先の案内を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板を背に右へ進み青い札の手前のベンチまでという説明を復唱し、休んでから次の区間を聞いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: With my back to the board, go right to the bench before the blue sign, correct? May I rest at the bench first, then hear the next directions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the directions to go right with your back to the board as far as the bench before the blue sign, and ask to hear the next section after resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、向きと目印は合っています。まずそこまでをご案内します。ベンチで休んでから、改札までの次の区間を確認しましょう。途中で目印がわからなくなったら、お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the direction and landmarks are correct. We'll guide you that far first. After resting at the bench, let's check the next section to the gates. If you lose track of the landmarks along the way, let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず案内板を背に右側の通路へ進み、青い札の手前で休みます。その先を一度に覚えようとせず、次の区間も言い直して確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最初の区間を右側の通路から青い札手前のベンチまで進んで休み、その先も区間ごとに復唱して確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: First, I'll take the right-hand path with my back to the board and rest before the blue sign. I won't try to remember everything beyond it at once; I'll repeat and check the next section too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will first take the right path to rest at the bench before the blue sign, and repeat and check the remaining route section by section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ゆっくりご移動ください。困った時はお声がけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please move at your own pace. Let us know if you need help. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご本人の情報について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about your personal information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 氏名の表記が変わったので、市の手続きに必要な書類を聞きたいです。新しいカードを持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氏名表記を変更したので、新しいカードを示して市の手続きに必要な書類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The spelling of my name has changed, so I'd like to ask what documents are needed for city procedures. I've brought my new card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you changed your name's spelling, show the new card, and ask what documents are needed for city procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの情報が変わったか確認します。新しい表記と、以前の記録がわかるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check which information changed. Do you have something showing the new spelling and previous records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このカードが新しい正式名で、この通知が以前の名です。普段使う呼び名とも違うので、三つを混ぜずに見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新しい正式名、以前の通知の名、日常の呼び名を混同せず、それぞれ示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This card has my new official name, and this notice has the previous one. They're also different from the name I use day to day, so I'll show all three without mixing them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish and show the new official name, previous name on a notice, and everyday name separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正式な氏名と通称などの扱いは、担当が確認します。どの市の手続きを予定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check how official names and commonly used names are handled. Which city procedures are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 保険の書類と、申請中の相談記録です。一つ直せば全て自動で変わると思わず、必要な窓口を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保険の書類と申請中の記録を確認したく、一か所の変更で全て変わるとは考えず窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Insurance documents and consultation records for an application in progress. I won't assume changing one updates everything automatically; I'd like to check the necessary counters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check insurance documents and pending-application records, and ask for the counters without assuming one change updates everything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当ごとの確認が必要なこともあります。申請中の番号がわかる控えもお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separate checks with different staff may be needed. Please also bring the reference showing the number of your pending application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えはこの番号です。手続きが途中なので、名前が違う別の申請として重複しないよう、変更と伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申請番号の控えを示し、新たな重複申請ではなく既存申請の情報変更だと伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is the reference number. Since it's still in progress, I want to describe it as a change so it isn't duplicated as another application under a different name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the application-number reference and say you want to explain this as updating an existing application rather than a duplicate new application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。新しい情報と申請番号を示し、既存の申請に関する変更として相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Show the new information and application number, and ask about a change related to the existing application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正式名の新旧と呼び名を区別し、保険と申請中の記録を確認します。必要書類と窓口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧の正式名と呼び名、保険と申請中の手続きを整理して、必要な窓口と書類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish my old and new official names from my everyday name, and check insurance and the pending records. Please tell me the required documents and counters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize old and new official names, everyday name, insurance, and pending procedures, and ask for the necessary counters and documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。書類の表記を確認して進めましょう。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the appropriate staff. Let's check the spellings on the documents as we proceed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。予約のことで、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your appointments?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供二人の予約があるのですが、上の子だけ変更したいです。二人とも取り消すことにならないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供二人のうち兄だけの予約を変更し、弟まで取消しにならないよう確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have appointments for two children, but want to change only the older child's. I'd like to make sure both won't be canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to change only the older brother's appointment among two children and ensure the younger brother's is not canceled too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれのお名前と予約票を見せてください。変更したいのは、どちらの患者さんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show each name and appointment slip. Which patient needs the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄はハルで、患者番号は314です。弟はレン、315で、弟の予約はそのままです。名字だけではなく、番号でも分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄ハルの患者番号314と弟レンの315を示し、弟の予約は維持すると指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The older brother is Haru, patient number 314. The younger is Ren, 315, and his appointment stays as it is. Please distinguish them by number too, not just surname.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give older brother Haru's patient number 314 and younger brother Ren's 315, and specify keeping the younger brother's appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 314のハルさんは変更希望、315のレンさんは変更せず、と別々に記録します。お兄さんの希望する日と理由を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll record separately that Haru, 314, requests a change and Ren, 315, has no change. Please tell me the older brother's preferred day and reason.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 兄は学校の行事があるので、別の日を希望します。弟は予定どおり連れてきます。二人の受診を無理に同じ日にまとめなくてよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄は学校行事で別日を希望するが弟は予定どおり受診し、二人を同日にまとめる必要はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: He has a school event, so we'd like another day. I'll bring his younger brother as scheduled. There's no need to force both visits onto the same day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the older brother needs another date for a school event but the younger attends as scheduled, and both do not need to be on the same day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ一人分の変更希望を伝えます。受診間隔など、医療担当の確認が必要な場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on the change request for one person. Medical staff may need to check matters such as the interval between visits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空いている日なら何でもよいと決めず、担当の確認を待ちます。連絡が来たら、兄の新日時と弟の元の日時を両方確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空き日だけで変更を決めず担当者の確認を待ち、兄の新日時と弟の元日時を両方確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't decide any open date is fine; I'll wait for staff confirmation. When they contact me, I'll check both the older brother's new date and time and the younger brother's original ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not choose based only on availability but wait for staff checks, and confirm both the older brother's new and younger brother's original date and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録を読み返します。ハルさん314は学校行事のため変更相談中、レンさん315は元の予約を維持しています。お兄さんの新しい日時はまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll read back the record. Haru, 314, is discussing a change due to a school event; Ren, 315, retains the original appointment. The older brother's new date and time are still undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その記録で合っています。314の兄だけが変更相談中で、315の弟は維持ですね。新日時の連絡が来たら、二枚の票に別々に記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 兄314だけが変更相談中で弟315は維持という読み返しを確認し、新日時の連絡後に二枚の票へ別々に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: That record is correct. Only the older brother, 314, is discussing a change, and the younger, 315, stays unchanged. Once the new date and time are communicated, I'll record them separately on the two slips.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the readback that only older brother 314 is discussing a change while younger brother 315 stays unchanged, and say you will record the two slips separately after the new time is communicated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、二人を一括取消しにはしていません。お兄さん一人の変更相談として担当に渡します。ご確認ありがとうございました。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we haven't canceled both together. I'll pass this to staff as a change consultation for the older brother alone. Thank you for checking. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。自転車について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about your bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 停めていた中古の自転車が見つかりません。登録の名前は前の持ち主かもしれませんが、私の自転車として相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中古自転車が見当たらず登録名は旧所有者かもしれないので、購入者として相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find the secondhand bicycle I parked. The registration may be in the previous owner's name, but I'd like to discuss it as my bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your secondhand bicycle is missing and may be registered under the previous owner, so you want to consult as its purchaser. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停めた場所と日時を伺います。ご購入や譲り受けたことがわかる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask where and when you parked it. Do you have documents showing you purchased or received it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日、建物の駐輪場所に置きました。店の購入書類があります。登録名と私の名前が違う点も隠さず伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日置いた駐輪場所と購入書類を示し、登録名と自分の名が違う点も説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I left it at the building's bicycle parking area yesterday. I have the shop's purchase documents. I'll openly explain that the registered name and mine differ too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show yesterday's parking location and purchase documents, and explain that your name differs from the registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入書類と車体情報を確認しましょう。色、形、車体番号などはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the purchase documents and bicycle information. Do you know the color, shape, frame number, and similar details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒い折り畳み自転車です。購入時の車体番号の写真があります。折り畳んで置いていたので、普通の大きい車体とは見え方が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒い折り畳み自転車で番号の写真があり、折り畳んで置いたため見え方が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a black folding bicycle. I have a photo of the frame number from purchase. I parked it folded, so it looks different from a normal full-sized bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is a black folding bicycle with a number photo and its appearance differs because you parked it folded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 置いた状態も記録します。管理者が移動したか、他の方が使っていないかは確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record the state it was parked in too. Have you checked whether management moved it or someone else is using it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理者へ聞きましたが、まだ返事はありません。盗難と決めず、移動確認中と伝えます。家族は使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者へ移動を照会中で返事はなく、家族は使っていないので盗難とはまだ断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've asked management, but haven't received a reply yet. I'll say movement is being checked rather than conclude theft. My family aren't using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say management has not replied to your relocation inquiry and family are not using it, so you are not yet concluding theft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた範囲を記録します。管理者の返事があれば、その内容もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record what has been confirmed. Please tell us the content of management's reply when it comes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 購入書類と車体番号、折り畳んだ駐輪状態を示します。登録名は旧所有者の可能性、移動は確認中として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入書類、番号、駐輪状態を示し、旧登録名の可能性と移動の確認状況を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the purchase documents, frame number, and folded parking state. I'll explain the possibility of the previous owner's registration and that relocation is being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show purchase documents, number, and parking state, and distinguish the possible previous registered name from the relocation-check status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。所有と車体の情報を確認して担当へつなぎます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check ownership and bicycle information and connect you with the staff. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送の記録について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about sending records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 応募書類を送ります。出した日を残したいのですが、追跡を付ければ差し出した控えももらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 応募書類を送った日を記録したいので、追跡を付けた場合に差し出した控えも受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending application documents and want a record of the day I send them. If I add tracking, can I also get a posting receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to record the sending date for application documents and ask whether a posting receipt is provided with tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な記録と利用できる方法を確認しましょう。提出先は、差出日と到着日のどちらを求めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the record you need and the methods available. Does the recipient require the posting date or arrival date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内は差出日の条件です。到着した表示だけではなく、私がいつ出したかを示す控えを保管したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 応募条件は到着日ではなく差出日なので、いつ出したかを示す控えを保管したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions specify a posting-date condition. Rather than only an arrival display, I'd like to keep a receipt showing when I sent it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the application condition concerns posting rather than arrival, so you want a receipt showing when you posted it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差出時の控えと、後から確認する追跡情報は別です。方法ごとの扱いをご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: A receipt at posting and tracking information checked afterward are separate. I'll explain how each method handles them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 応募先から配達の証明までは求められていません。必要のない記録まで付けず、条件に合う方法を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達の証明までは求められていないため、条件に合う発送方法と必要な記録を比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The application recipient hasn't requested proof of delivery. I'd like to compare methods meeting the conditions without adding unnecessary records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say proof of delivery isn't required, so you want to compare suitable sending methods and necessary records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件と費用を比べて選べます。宛先、書類の内容、梱包も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare conditions and costs before choosing. Let's check the address, document contents, and packaging too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中は応募書類だけです。宛名と期限の案内を見せるので、今日差し出す記録が残る方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中身は応募書類だけで、宛名と期限の案内を示し、今日差し出す記録を残せる方法を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only application documents are inside. I'll show the address and deadline instructions, so please check a method leaving a record of posting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the contents are application documents only, show the address and deadline instructions, and ask to check a method recording today's posting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録に表示される日付の扱いも確認してご案内します。提出先の受理判断は、提出先へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also check and explain how dates are shown in the record. Please confirm the recipient's acceptance decision with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 差出の控えと追跡を分けて保管します。条件に合う方法を選び、応募書類の写しも残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出時の控えと追跡情報を分けて保管し、条件に合う方法を選んで応募書類の写しも残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the posting receipt and tracking separately. I'll choose a method meeting the conditions and keep copies of the application documents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will store the posting receipt separately from tracking, choose a method meeting the conditions, and keep copies of the application documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発送方法を確認してからお預かりします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll accept it after confirming the sending method. Thank you for your inquiry.
